evaluation: ANLI v1.0 round 1 development and test, CC BY-NC 4.0 noncommercial research only
selection: Fixed SHA-256 ordering per class; 40 development and 100 held-out test per class; reject exact normalized premise overlap, duplicate pair hashes and IDs before inference
limitations: ANLI adversarial English inference is not a representative current-fact verification corpus.
Not in the model's declared SNLI/MultiNLI fine-tuning data; undisclosed overlap and backbone pretraining overlap remain unknown.
